merges.incoming_headline: St. Lucie Fire Board Member Calls for Chief Jeff Lee's Resignation
shared_anchors: hazing investigation / firing of three firefighters
merges.reason: This is a direct continuation of the same ongoing St. Lucie Fire District leadership crisis covered in the 9/30 canonical (same chief, same no-confidence vote, same hazing fallout, same attorney Sabol). The incoming article adds material new developments: specific vote percentages, a board member's explicit call for the chief's resignation, Gonzalez's reassignment, and the status of settlement talks for the fired firefighters. These are updates to the continuing proceeding rather than a distinct new accountability story, so the existing canonical should be updated.
novel_facts: Union vote results now quantified: 74% no confidence in Lee, 92% in Assistant Chief Gonzalez, 97% in Sabol
Fire board member/commissioner James Clasby publicly calls for Lee's resignation
Gonzalez reassigned from assistant chief to battalion chief, raising questions
Sabol's retirement effective in December confirmed
Union rep says settlement offers for fired firefighters are now off the table
Board to continue complaint-process overhaul at Oct. 21 meeting
